en: a. worth remembering or likely to be remembered; very special or impressive; easy to remember
ex: It was a memorable trip that I will never forget.
那是一趟我永遠不會忘記的難忘旅行。

en: n. kindness and forgiveness shown to someone you have power over; a lucky event; the act of not punishing someone severely
ex: The judge showed mercy and gave him a light sentence.
法官展現仁慈，給了他輕判。

en: a. used to emphasize how small or unimportant something is; nothing more than; n. (old) a small lake or pond
ex: The mere thought of flying makes him nervous.
光是想到搭飛機就讓他緊張。

en: n. the quality of being good and deserving praise; an advantage or good point of something; vt. to deserve something such as attention or praise; vi. to deserve something
ex: The plan has a lot of merit and deserves serious consideration.
這個計畫很有價值，值得認真考慮。

en: n. an instrument that makes very small objects look bigger so that you can see them clearly
ex: We looked at the cells under a microscope.
我們用顯微鏡觀察細胞。

en: n. a building where grain is crushed into flour; a factory where a particular material is made; a machine for crushing something into small pieces; vt. to crush or grind something; vi. to move around in a crowd without purpose
ex: The old mill by the river grinds wheat into flour.
河邊的老磨坊把小麥磨成麵粉。

en: n. a person whose job is to dig coal, gold or other minerals from under the ground; a machine used in mining; a soldier who lays mines
ex: The miners went deep underground to dig for coal.
礦工深入地下挖煤。

en: n. bad luck; an unfortunate event; a situation in which something unlucky happens
ex: He bore his misfortune with great courage.
他以極大的勇氣面對自己的不幸。

en: vt. to make someone believe something that is not true; to lead someone in the wrong direction; to give someone a wrong idea about something
ex: The advertisement misled customers about the product's quality.
這則廣告就產品品質誤導了顧客。

en: vt. to fail to understand someone or something correctly; to get the wrong idea about something
ex: I think you misunderstood what I said.
我覺得你誤解了我說的話。

en: a. not having or showing a high opinion of yourself; not very large or expensive; (of clothes) not showing too much of the body; shy
ex: She is very modest about her achievements.
她對自己的成就非常謙虛。

en: n. the quality of not being too proud of yourself; shyness or decency in how you behave or dress; the quality of being simple and not showy
ex: She accepted the award with great modesty.
她謙虛地接受了這個獎項。

en: n. a screen that shows images or information from a computer; a student chosen to help the teacher; a device used to watch or check something; v. to watch and check something over a period of time; to listen to something carefully
ex: The nurse monitors the patient's heartbeat constantly.
護理師持續監測病人的心跳。

en: n. a building, statue or pillar built to remind people of a famous person or event; a structure that is built in memory of a dead person; a very old building or place that has historical importance
ex: The monument was built to honor the soldiers who died in the war.
這座紀念碑是為了紀念戰爭中犧牲的士兵而建。

en: vt. to make someone want to do something; to give someone a reason for doing something; to encourage someone to do their best
ex: A good teacher knows how to motivate students.
好老師知道如何激勵學生。

en: n. the reason why someone does something; enthusiasm for doing something; a desire or willingness to do something; the process of giving someone a reason to do something
ex: She lacks the motivation to finish her homework.
她缺乏完成作業的動力。

en: a. more than one; involving many people or things; of or with many parts; n. a number that can be divided by another number exactly
ex: The company has multiple offices around the world.
公司在世界各地有多個辦公室。

en: n. a soft, low sound of people speaking quietly; a quiet continuous sound; a complaint made in a low voice; vi. to speak very quietly; vt. to say something very quietly
ex: She murmured a few words and then fell asleep.
她低聲說了幾句話，然後就睡著了。

en: a. having very little money or food; in need of help; lacking the basic things that are needed to live; needing someone's love and attention all the time
ex: The charity helps needy families in the community.
這個慈善機構幫助社區中的貧困家庭。

en: n. the failure to take care of someone or something; the state of being ignored or not looked after; vt. to fail to take care of someone or something; to fail to do something that you should do
ex: The old building has fallen into neglect.
那棟舊建築已淪為荒廢。

en: vi. to try to reach an agreement by discussing something; vt. to arrange something by discussing it; to successfully travel through or over a difficult area; to sell or transfer something such as a check
ex: The two sides are negotiating a peace agreement.
雙方正在協商和平協議。

en: adv. in spite of what has just been said; however; conj. used to say that something is true in spite of something else
ex: The weather was bad; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
天氣不好；儘管如此，我們還是去散步。

en: a. having or showing fine moral qualities such as honesty and generosity; belonging to a high social class; impressive and beautiful; n. a person of high social rank
ex: Helping others is a noble thing to do.
幫助別人是一件高尚的事。

en: adv. at the present time, compared with the past; in the present age; n. the present time
ex: Nowadays, most people use smartphones.
現在大多數人都使用智慧型手機。

en: a. relating to the energy produced by splitting atoms; relating to the nucleus of an atom or cell; relating to weapons that use atomic energy; (of a family) consisting of parents and children
ex: The country has built several nuclear power plants.
該國已建了數座核電廠。

en: a. many; existing in large numbers; consisting of a large number of people or things
ex: There are numerous cafés along this street.
這條街上有許多咖啡館。

en: n. a place where very young children are taken care of while their parents are at work; a place where young plants are grown for sale; a place where something develops
ex: She works at a nursery looking after toddlers.
她在托兒所照顧幼兒。

en: n. the act of doing what someone tells you to do; the quality of obeying rules or orders; willingness to follow someone's orders
ex: The soldiers showed complete obedience to their commander.
士兵們對指揮官表現出完全的服從。

en: n. something that blocks your way and prevents you from making progress; a problem that stops you from achieving something; a fence or other thing that blocks a path
ex: Language was the biggest obstacle for the new immigrants.
語言是新移民面臨的最大障礙。

en: vt. to get something, especially by making an effort; to gain something that you want; vi. (formal) (of a rule or custom) to be in use or exist
ex: He obtained a scholarship to study abroad.
他獲得了出國留學的獎學金。

en: a. happening sometimes but not often; (of a person) doing something sometimes but not regularly; not regular or frequent
ex: We enjoy an occasional trip to the countryside.
我們偶爾喜歡去鄉下玩。

en: n. a person's job or profession; the act of taking and controlling a place by force; the activity of living in a place; the period of time during which a place is occupied
ex: What is your occupation?
你的職業是什麼？

en: vt. to live in or use a place; to take up time or space; to take control of a place by force; to keep someone busy
ex: The family has occupied the house for fifty years.
這個家庭已經住在這棟房子裡五十年了。

en: vt. to hurt someone's feelings; to make someone feel upset or angry; vi. to break a law or rule; to commit a crime
ex: I hope I haven't offended you with my remarks.
我希望我的話沒有冒犯到你。

en: vt. to disagree with something and try to stop it; to fight against someone or something; to compete against someone; vi. to be against something
ex: Many people oppose the construction of the new airport.
許多人反對興建新機場。

en: n. a large group of musicians who play together using many kinds of instruments; the area in front of a stage where the musicians sit; the seats on the ground floor of a theater
ex: The orchestra played a beautiful piece by Beethoven.
管弦樂團演奏了一首優美的貝多芬作品。

en: adv. in a different way or state; if not; apart from that; in other respects
ex: Hurry up, otherwise we will miss the train.
快一點，否則我們會趕不上火車。

en: n. the final result of an action, process or event; a result that is not known until later; (old use) the place where something comes out
ex: We are still waiting for the outcome of the election.
我們還在等待選舉的結果。

en: a. extremely good or impressive; much better than others; (of a debt or payment) still owed; (of a problem) not yet solved
ex: She received an award for her outstanding contribution to science.
她因對科學的傑出貢獻而獲得獎項。

en: n. a shape like a circle that is longer than it is wide; something that has this shape; a. shaped like an egg
ex: The race track is an oval shape.
賽道是橢圓形。
